Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Reliability
Fabrikam Payments (a made-up company)

We are hiring a senior backend engineer to keep our payment APIs fast and dependable.

What you will do
- Build and run payment services in Go, backed by Redis and PostgreSQL.
- Own SLO compliance for customer-facing checkout APIs, with clear metrics and alerting.
- Take part in on-call and help lead incident response and follow-ups.
- Move our services to Kubernetes.

What you bring
- 6+ years building backend services.
- Experience with caching, latency work and high-traffic payment systems.
